summary: Lasso, URLgenius and Button/Posttap were quiet.
Bitly's consumer survey: 79% have abandoned after a social link landed on a homepage instead of the product, and 48% say branded short links make them comfortable clicking.
ShopMy hired ex-Trade Desk exec Jed Dederick as chief revenue officer to scale creator commerce.
Amazon's news was all new Alexa and Echo devices, nothing on Associates, OneLink or Influencer.
YouTube ad growth slowed to 9% while paid subscriptions passed 150 million.

items.title: Amazon unveils its newest lineup of Alexa devices
items.why: Device launches only; nothing on Amazon's affiliate or creator tools.

items.title: Bitly’s New Data Says SEOs Are Half Right About Short Links
items.why: Bitly's survey backs the case for branded links that go straight to the product page with few redirects, and says in-app browsers often strip tracking. That's the problem Geniuslink solves, and Bitly is using it in its marketing.

items.title: ShopMy Taps Ex-Trade Desk Vet Jed Dederick as CRO to Scale Creator Commerce
items.why: ShopMy is hiring for ad-industry scale and measurement, a sign creator commerce platforms are trying to look like big ad channels.
